title: Kids Camera Cute Cartoon Dinosaur Design Multifunction 2.0 Inch Display 400mAh Selfie Digital Camera For Kids Girls And Boys Blue
body_html: 1、KIDS CAMERA: This kids digital camera comes with dual cameras, video recording, and a 2.0 inch HD IPS screen to protect children's eyes. It also has auto focus, 8x digital zoom. Your kids can take photos, record videos, play games, and take selfies with the photo frame. 2、MULTIFUNCTIONAL: This kids camera offers more functions besides photo and video recording, including playback, continuous recording, self timer, classic filters, cute cartoon frames. Your kids can take photos anytime and anywhere. It can play puzzle games and music. 3、LONG BATTERY LIFE: This kids camcorder has a built in rechargeable lithium battery, easy and convenient to charge. It can work for up to 2‑3 hours (varies with usage and other factors). It also has an auto shut off function if not operated to preserve battery life. 4、CARTOON DESIGN: This kids camera comes with a cute case that provides effective drop protection, making the toy camera safer and more durable. In addition, this package includes a durable lanyard for kids to wear the camera around their neck. 5、GIFT TOY: Perfect birthday, Christmas and holiday gift for boys and girls aged 3‑12. This kids camera is made of premium silicone material, which is shockproof, eco friendly and nontoxic.
